perception, language) are modular.
·In Fodorian modularity, high-level systems $(e$.g., reasoning) are not modular.
$\cdot 2003$: cognitive scientist Peter Carruthers proposed the massive modularity hypothesis (MMH).

prompt.text:

content.text:
In considering some but not all cognitive systems modular, Fodorian modularity is not as
expansive in its definition of modularity as MMH is.

Following Fodor’s 1983 hypothesis, Carruthers proposed that modularity of mind includes all
cognitive systems.

The hypotheses of Fodor and Carruthers differ in whether they consider low-level cognitive
systems, such as perception and language, modular.
